parameters.query:
SELECT 
  e.id,
  e.first_name,
  e.last_name,
  e.email,
  e.phone,
  e.avatar_url,
  e.designation,
  e.joining_date,
  e.employment_type,
  e.work_location,
  e.role,
  e.is_active,
  (CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS is_authenticated
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN employees e 
  ON (LOWER(e.email) = LOWER('{{ ($json.body.identifier || $json.body.employeeIdOrEmail || "").trim() }}') 
      OR e.id = '{{ ($json.body.identifier || $json.body.employeeIdOrEmail || "").trim() }}')
 AND (
   e.password_hash = crypt('{{ ($json.body.password || "").trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}', e.password_hash)
   OR e.password_hash = '{{ ($json.body.password || "").trim().replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
 )
 AND e.is_active = TRUE
LIMIT 1;
